topic: Chat bot response handling and UI implementation
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on implementing the display of chat bot responses within a user interface. Initially, it was confirmed that the response structure would always include a text component.

[p1] pushed an initial UI version for the prompt functionality. This implementation currently extracts the `message` field from the API response to display the textual part and assigns other parameters needed for server requests to `this.params`. The data is then sent to the server and displayed on the traffic page.

However, a key architectural discussion point was raised: displaying chat history. For full functionality, each historical bot answer must trigger its own separate request to the server to populate the corresponding response data on the traffic page. Alternatively, the simplest approach would be to forgo history entirely and only display the current question/answer pair.
decisions: The initial UI implementation for prompt handling was pushed by [p1].
action_items: Discuss the optimal method for displaying chat history (per-response server requests vs. no history).
